links.outcome: Expert-rated guideline concordance of LLM answers to bariatric surgery questions (0-3 scale)
links.effect: DeepSeek-V3 2.44±0.40, ChatGPT-4o 1.79±0.46, Gemini 2.0 Flash 1.63±0.47 (p<0.001); fully concordant (score 3) in 80% DeepSeek vs 0% ChatGPT and 3.3% Gemini.
links.quote: Fully guideline-concordant ratings (score = 3) were most frequent for DeepSeek (80%) vs. ChatGPT (0%) and Gemini (3.3%).

links.outcome: LLM performance on guideline-based specialty questions, showing need for domain validation
links.effect: Models differed significantly in guideline concordance; ChatGPT and Gemini rarely fully concordant, indicating general-purpose performance may not reflect specialty competence.
links.quote: These results highlight the need for ongoing, domain-focused validation before clinical use.

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the accuracy and guideline concordance of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, Gemini 2.0 Flash, DeepSeek-V3) on standardized metabolic and bariatric surgery clinical questions rated by experts, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
